hero.headline: The operating system for your cap table, raise, and exit.
hero.subhead: VenturePath is a Sharia-compliant cap table, fundraising, and connections platform for Saudi and MENA founders. iSAFE, SAFE, and ordinary instruments. Bilingual. Off-platform closing for compliance.
features.heading: What's included
features.cap_table.title: Cap table
features.cap_table.body: Sharia-compliant instruments (iSAFE, SAFE, Convertible Note, Ordinary). Ownership math, dilution, waterfall — all in one place.
features.rounds.title: Fundraising rounds
features.rounds.body: Track investor pipeline, term sheets, closing checklists, and investor updates. Convert iSAFEs to ordinary on close, automatically.
features.esop.title: ESOP
features.esop.body: Option pool, grants, vesting schedules. Track vested options per teammate in real time.
features.governance.title: Governance
features.governance.body: Board meetings, resolutions, and templates aligned with KSA company law and your articles.
features.compliance.title: Compliance
features.compliance.body: Track ZATCA, GAZT, MOC, and other obligations. Get reminders before they're due.
features.vault.title: Document vault
features.vault.body: Tiered access (intro / standard / diligence). Share signed token links to investors without granting workspace access.
features.traction.title: Traction
features.traction.body: MRR, customers, runway. Publish to your public profile or keep private.
features.marketplace.title: Secondary marketplace
features.marketplace.body: Posted-ask bulletin board for shareholders selling part of their equity. Built-in ROFR (right of first refusal) notifications to existing shareholders.
features.connections.title: Connections Hub
features.connections.body: Cross-workspace marketplace for whole-company exits and founder partnerships. Verified cap-table data beats anonymous AngelList posts.
features.public_profile.title: Public profile
features.public_profile.body: Choose what to publish: company, traction, open rounds. Discoverable on /explore by investors and partners.
features.bilingual.title: Bilingual EN/AR + RTL
features.bilingual.body: Every page works in Arabic right-to-left with Cairo for Arabic and Inter for Latin. KSA-first throughout.
differentiators.heading: Why founders choose VenturePath
differentiators.sharia.title: Sharia-compliant by design
differentiators.sharia.body: iSAFE is our wedge — convertible instrument designed for Sharia compliance and KSA market reality.
differentiators.ksa.title: KSA-first, not US-bolted
differentiators.ksa.body: SAR-native amounts, ZATCA-aware compliance, Hijri-friendly dates, Cairo + Inter typography, RTL throughout.
differentiators.trust.title: Verified data is the moat
differentiators.trust.body: Other marketplaces have anonymous profiles. VenturePath listings are anchored to verified cap tables and audited financials.
cta.heading: Build your cap table in the next 10 minutes.
cta.subheading: Free during beta. No fund movement on platform — you stay in control of every deal.
footer.tagline: Sharia-compliant cap table for KSA founders.
